text.en: The sitio of Bagong Pook is separated from the barrio of Arumahan, Municipality of Lemery, Province of Batangas, and constituted into a barrio in the said municipality to be known as the barrio of Bagong Pook.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
